description: A five-step sequencer with five knobs and five outputs, each output reading a different knob on every step so that all five voltages rotate around the outputs together

params.text: Sets how far each output slides toward its new voltage before the next step arrives; fully anticlockwise steps instantly, and the slide is timed from the measured gap between triggers
Sets one of the five voltages the outputs rotate through, -5V to 5V
Sets one of the five voltages the outputs rotate through, -5V to 5V
Sets one of the five voltages the outputs rotate through, -5V to 5V
Sets one of the five voltages the outputs rotate through, -5V to 5V
Sets one of the five voltages the outputs rotate through, -5V to 5V
Advances the sequence by one step on each press
Returns the sequence to its first step on each press

inputs.text: A rising edge advances the sequence by one step
Above 1V the knobs are read in the star order, and at or below 1V in the circle order
Added to every output voltage, before the total is clamped to -10 to 10V
Above 1V the rotation runs anticlockwise, and at or below 1V clockwise
A rising edge returns the sequence to its first step
Overrides the slew knob and moves it: 0-10V is read as the whole knob travel

outputs.text: One of the five rotating voltages, slewed and shifted, clamped to -10 to 10V

notes: the outputs do not move until a trigger arrives, either at the TRIG input or from the button beside it
the slew time is measured from the gap between the last two triggers, so a change of clock tempo is followed automatically
menu: Enable Polyphonic Output to Channel A — gathers all five output voltages into the A output as five polyphonic channels
